Related: Bitwise fund is first Solana ETF to hit $1 billion AUM (The Block).

Treat these as directional planning ranges, not a base-case forecast. Related: Three critical US reports arrive in 30 minutes as Bitcoin’s $2.5 billion ETF streak faces its first real test - CryptoRank (Google News (crypto ETP / ETF)).
  • The filing pipeline remains crowded: Most filings will not scale, but active pipelines still foreshadow which issuers and custodians will compete hardest for the next wave of listings. Related: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF hits $5B in tax-deferre... - Pluang (Google News (spot Bitcoin ETF)).
  • Product access expanded quickly, then concentrated: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETP approvals in 2024 (see ) widened listed access fast—yet the top three funds still carry about 67% of listed AUM here (IBIT ($60.65B), FBTC ($13.88B), GBTC ($10.38B)). For allocators and service providers, scale and distribution economics now matter at least as much as first-mover timing.
